targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(received_at) AS time,
       quantiles(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(delivery_delay)[1] / 1000 AS p50,
       quantiles(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(delivery_delay)[2] / 1000 AS p90,
       quantiles(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(delivery_delay)[3] / 1000 AS p99
FROM events
WHERE project_id = ${project:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(received_at) AS time,
       sum(ifNull(dropped_memory_overflow, 0)) AS `Memory overflow`,
       sum(ifNull(dropped_disk_overflow, 0)) AS `Disk overflow`,
       sum(ifNull(dropped_expired, 0)) AS Expired,
       sum(ifNull(dropped_send_error, 0)) AS `Send error`
FROM uploads
WHERE project_id = ${project:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND status = 'stored'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT sum(ifNull(dropped_memory_overflow, 0) + ifNull(dropped_disk_overflow, 0)
           + ifNull(dropped_expired, 0) + ifNull(dropped_send_error, 0)) AS `Lost events`,
       `Lost events` / nullIf(`Lost events` + sum(events), 0) AS `Lost share`
FROM uploads
WHERE project_id = ${project:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND status = 'stored'

SELECT
  (SELECT sum(rejected) FROM uploads
   WHERE project_id = ${project:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) AS `Rejected lines`,
  (SELECT count() - uniqExact(call_id, resend_count, start_time) FROM events
   WHERE project_id = ${project:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) AS `Duplicate events`

SELECT $__timeInterval(received_at) AS time, concat(toString(response_code), ' ', status) AS status, count() AS uploads
FROM uploads
WHERE project_id = ${project:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
GROUP BY time, status
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(received_at) AS time, sdk_version, count() AS events
FROM events
WHERE project_id = ${project:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
GROUP BY time, sdk_version
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(received_at) AS time, project_id AS project, count() AS events
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
GROUP BY time, project
ORDER BY time

SELECT table AS Table, sum(rows) AS Rows, sum(bytes_on_disk) AS `Size on disk`, count() AS Parts
FROM system.parts
WHERE active AND database = 'telemetry'
GROUP BY table
ORDER BY `Size on disk` DESC

SELECT name AS Disk, free_space AS Free, total_space AS Total, free_space / total_space AS `Free share`
FROM system.disks
